valve.label: Turn the ball valve
valve.caption: Grasp the lever, swing it through its quarter turn, leave it shut.

lamp.label: Change the lamp
lamp.caption: Unscrew the bulb out of its socket, hold it clear, screw it back home.

breaker.label: Flip the circuit breaker
breaker.caption: Close the gripper and sweep the toggle across to its other stop.

high-valve.label: Open the gate valve
high-valve.caption: Pinch the handwheel rim and wind it round a full turn.

small-valve.label: Open the small gate valve
small-valve.caption: Take the little handwheel by its rim and wind it open.

thread-m30.label: Run the M30 nut up its thread
thread-m30.caption: Grip the hex across its flats and wind it up the stud.

thread-m8.label: Run the M8 nut up its thread
thread-m8.caption: Pinch the small hex nut and wind it up the screw.

peg-insertion.label: Draw and reseat the peg
peg-insertion.caption: Pull the peg clear of its plate, then feed it back down the hole.

button-cover.label: Press the hidden button
button-cover.caption: Swing the cover off the button, then press it home.

key-lock.label: Work the key
key-lock.caption: Turn the key through the lock, draw it part way out and feed it back, then turn it home again.

drawer.label: Pull the drawer open
drawer.caption: Pinch the drawer front and draw it out of its case.
